consequence.statement: ExternalSecret v1beta1 resources with spec.target.template.engineVersion set to v1 are rejected by the API server since the value is removed from the enum.
consequence.remediation: Change engineVersion to an allowed value (e.g. remove v1 setting) before applying.

original.statement: ExternalSecret v1beta1 schema: allowed values changed: `spec.target.template.engineVersion`

decision.reason: The computed artifact diff between the v0.15.0 CRD bundle [ev-9889c9b8706d] and the v0.16.0 CRD bundle [ev-e08924afdc47] shows "v1" was removed from the enum for spec.target.template.engineVersion in the ExternalSecret v1beta1 schema, with nothing added. A value removed from a CRD enum fails API-server schema validation. So resource-rejected is the right kind for v1beta1 ExternalSecrets that set engineVersion to v1, and severity high is reasonable. The bundle excerpts themselves are minimal and nothing explains why the value was removed, so this rests on the deterministic diff alone. That is why confidence is low.
